title: Weeds or Wildflowers?
content: Studying the exquisite geometry of wildflowers (mullein, milkweed, and goldenrod) brings to mind the 1911 poem by Ella Wheeler Wilcox.THE WEEDA weed is but an unloved flower!Go dig, and prune, and guide, and wait,Until it learns its high estate,And glorifies some bower.A weed is but an unloved flower!All sin is virtue unevolved,Release the angel from the clod--Go love thy brother up to God.Behold each problem solved.All sin is virtue unevolved.
